svg.title: Multi-Region Azure AI Platform Reference Architecture
svg.desc: Azure Architecture Center style diagram for a production AI platform spanning UAE North and UK Central with Traffic Manager, APIM, App Service orchestration, Azure AI Search, GPT-4o, Document Intelligence, shared services, hub-spoke networking, security, and governance.
svg.text: Multi-Region Azure AI Platform Reference Architecture
Production landing zone design with private AI services, hub-spoke networking, RAG flow, and DNS-based regional failover
Clients consume AI experiences through governed API access and regional failover.
Strategic option for L7 acceleration and security edge
Option A: Full warm DR with secondary model deployment
Option B: Degraded DR mode without GPT inference
Knowledge sources and ingestion | UAE North
DR-ready custom models for Document Intelligence
sub-sharedservices-01 | Shared platform services, monitoring, and private DNS
Private endpoint DNS and recovery orchestration
VNet peering, DNS forwarding, and private endpoint reachability
1. Traffic Manager is the current DNS-based global routing layer.
2. Azure Front Door is the strategic future enhancement.
3. APIM multi-region design depends on Premium classic support.
4. GPT-4o PTU is in UAE North; UK Central is warm DR or degraded DR.
App Service / Orchestrator → AI Search → GPT-4o → APIM → response
Storage / documents → Document Intelligence → chunking / indexing → AI Search
Spoke VNet → Hub VNet → Firewall / DNS resolver → private endpoints
Traffic Manager failover → UK Central warm DR or degraded mode
Diagram intent: Azure Architecture Center style board-review artifact with clear landing zone, network, and production-versus-DR boundaries.
